name: Subscription Agent
does: Lists every recurring charge in your statements
Flags free trials that turned paid
Drafts the cancel messages for you

beats.say: You're probably paying for a subscription you forgot about. So we built an agent for it.

beats.label: Upload 3 months of statements
beats.say: Upload three months of bank statements. Black out the account numbers first.

beats.label: Reading every charge
beats.say: It reads every charge, matches the ones that repeat, and catches the yearly renewals and the free trials that quietly turned paid.

beats.title: Monthly sweep
beats.say: You get one list with the yearly cost of each, so you can decide what stays.

beats.title: Cancel request
beats.text:
Hi, please cancel my membership effective today and confirm in writing.
Please also confirm no further charges will be made to my card.
Thank you.
beats.say: Then it writes the cancel messages. You check them and send them yourself.
The Subscription Agent is a ten dollar Claude prompt kit. Comment SUBS for the free guide.
